summary: Recovery-focused week with a single 10-minute power test on Wednesday; all other sessions are low-intensity base work to rebuild fitness after recent reduced training.

days.description: Easy spin to begin the week gently. Keep effort conversational and stay in Z1-Z2 throughout. This is about aerobic activation, not stress.

structure.label: Full session
structure.notes: Steady, comfortable pace. Heart rate 100–130 bpm. Spin easy on flat or rolling terrain. Focus on smooth pedal strokes.

days.description: Another easy ride to accumulate low-intensity volume. Slightly longer than Monday but same effort level—this builds base fitness without fatigue.

structure.label: Full session
structure.notes: Relaxed pace, keep HR below 130 bpm. Gravel is fine. Aim for steady, rhythmic breathing—you should be able to chat.

days.description: Short, controlled session built around your 10-minute power test. Warm up well, then perform the test, then cool down. This gauges current fitness without excessive fatigue.

structure.label: Warm-up
structure.notes: Easy spin for 10 minutes, then 2–3 short 20–30 second buildups to 90–100% effort to prime the system.

structure.label: 10-minute power test
structure.notes: All-out sustainable effort for exactly 10 minutes. Record average power. Treat it as a fitness checkpoint, not a race.

structure.label: Cool-down
structure.notes: Easy spin to recover. Let HR drop back to Z1-Z2 range. Focus on breathing and relaxation.

days.description: Recovery spin after Wednesday's test. Keep intensity very low to allow the central nervous system to recover from the high-intensity effort.

structure.label: Full session
structure.notes: Very easy, conversational pace. HR should stay below 125 bpm. This is genuine recovery—no hard efforts.

days.description: Slightly longer easy ride to build weekly volume. Same low intensity, just a bit more time on the bike.

structure.label: Full session
structure.notes: Steady, comfortable ride. Gravel terrain is fine. Aim for even pacing and smooth cadence. Stay relaxed.

days.description: Longer easy ride to cap the week and build aerobic base. This is your longest session of the week, but intensity remains low.

structure.label: Full session
structure.notes: Extended steady effort at comfortable pace. HR 105–130 bpm. Break it into two 60-minute sections mentally if helpful. Stay hydrated and well-fuelled.

days.description: Full rest day. No riding. Use this time to recover physically and mentally, prepare kit, and plan the week ahead.
